symptoms: above_ground: Water stress Nutrient stress Yellowing Wilting Stunting below_ground: Galls on roots, bulbs, and tubers Plant death in high infestations
description: Meloidogyne incognita is a plant-parasitic roundworm that attacks roots of a wide variety of plants, causing large irregular galls. It is one of the most common and economically important root-knot nematodes worldwide.
management: cultural_control: Crop rotation with nonhost or resistant varieties Use of organic amendments Plant antagonistic crops like Crotalaria spectabilis and Tagetes species biological_control: Egg-parasitic fungi such as Paecilomyces lilacinus chemical_control: Several nematicides available commercially
